Local Habitat for Humanity ReStore Closes Doors After 10-Years
Old Colony Habitat for Humanity's ReStore in Attleboro has permanently closed its doors after serving the community for ten years, the organization announced this week. The ReStore operated on a model that benefited both the environment and affordable housing, accepting new and gently used items that might otherwise end up in landfills and selling them at significant discounts. All proceeds directly funded Old Colony Habitat's home building projects, which provide affordable housing to families in need.

Meet The Little Dog Who Traveled Across Countries To Find Her Forever Family
Great Dog Rescue New England, a dedicated foster-based dog rescue in Massachusetts, would like you to meet Pukita, a little 15-pound girl who has been through quite a journey. The specific details of Pukita’s early life are shrouded in mystery, but she somehow found herself living as a stray at a landfill in Mexico. When she was discovered, workers called a local rescue, who in turn brought Pukita, as well as over 30 other cats and dogs, to a local park to hopefully find potential homes. It was there that the Great Dog Rescue New England team came upon Pukita while they were visiting Mexico. According to them, “It's been a long journey to get this girl medical records and a passport, but we're happy to say that she is coming to New England at the end of June, and now she is looking for a family to love and call her own.”

He still draws several cartoons a week and distributes them through his own syndicate. Through Heller Syndication, his cartoons regularly appear in more than 400 newspapers, making him the most successful self-syndicated editorial cartoonist in the nation. His cartoons are reprinted many times in USA Today, Denver Post, St. Paul Pioneer Press, The New York Times, the Los Angeles Times, Newsweek Japan, The Week and The Washington Post. Joe’s cartoons have won numerous distinctions, including 10 Best of Gannett awards, eight Milwaukee Press Club awards and two Honorable mentions for the John Fischetti Award.
